opening.argument: The central character of this video is a personal account of an accidental mistake, followed by an apology and advice rather than a transaction or solicitation. The speaker explains that he believed the link was correct, but that it unexpectedly led Sam to a porn website: "I told her that was the link because I thought it was. She went on the link and was like, oh my god! And it turned out it was a porn website." He then addresses Sam directly, saying, "But, Sam, I give you permission to get me back at some point," and apologizes: "But, Sorry Sam. I'm sorry about that." The direct-to-camera discussion contains no offer, payment flow, URL promotion, data request, or creator solicitation, supporting its character as general personal and entertainment-oriented discussion.
